name: Mullet River
blurb: Mullet River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: A shallow-marsh paddle between two DNR-listed unimproved carry-ins. The Highway G facility area is on the impounded side of Mullet Creek Dam. Take out at the designated marsh-side carry-in and stay well clear of the water-control outlet; this trip does not include passage over the dam, a portage or a downstream relaunch. Water levels, drawdowns and vegetation may prevent a practical through paddle. Check current conditions and property postings with DNR before launching. Area markers identify facilities, not surveyed landings.
sections.distanceReview: The 2.0-mile planning value is a preliminary hydrography measurement through shallow Mullet Marsh, not a reviewed navigable course between usable landings. The access map is available for facility orientation; trip-time estimates remain unavailable.

notices.title: Marsh take-out beside a control structure
notices.text: DNR lists both Deerview Drive and Highway G as unimproved carry-ins and allows canoeing in Mullet Creek Wildlife Area. The Highway G area marker is on the marsh side of Mullet Creek Dam. Use the designated carry-in and keep clear of the outlet; no through-dam route or portage is offered. Managed drawdowns and dense vegetation can limit paddling.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Mullet Creek Wildlife Area and public access inventory

putInAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
putInAccess.note: Fresh DNR public-access record identifies a state-owned unimproved carry-in and is not marked abandoned. The DNR property map also identifies boat access in Mullet Creek Wildlife Area, where canoeing is an allowed recreational activity. The original agency facility coordinate is retained as an Area marker; exact landing, water depth, vegetation clearance and present-day usability are not field-verified. No surveyed shoreline connector or bank side is claimed.
putInAccess.directions: Use the DNR-listed Deerview Drive carry-in at the Mullet Marsh road crossing. Follow the designated public approach and posted parking instructions; the marker is the original bridge/access-area coordinate, not an exact shoreline entry. Expect shallow marsh water, emergent vegetation and possible drawdowns; confirm a usable launch before setting a shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — public boat access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Fresh DNR public-access record identifies a state-owned unimproved carry-in and is not marked abandoned. The DNR property map also identifies boat access in Mullet Creek Wildlife Area, where canoeing is an allowed recreational activity. The original agency facility coordinate is retained as an Area marker; exact landing, water depth, vegetation clearance and present-day usability are not field-verified. No surveyed shoreline connector or bank side is claimed. DNR dam record 861 is approximately 17 metres from the facility marker. Imagery places the marker on the impounded marsh side, not a confirmed landing edge. This identifies a take-out area above the control structure, not a route through it.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed DNR carry-in approach from County Highway G to the Mullet Marsh access area. The agency marker identifies the marsh side of the dike, close to Mullet Creek Dam; take out at the designated carry-in and stay clear of the water-control outlet. Do not continue through the control structure or assume a portage or downstream relaunch. Follow property postings and check drawdown and vegetation conditions with DNR.

gaugeContext.note: This station is downstream of the accessed reach. Its readings are reference information, not a measured flow for every section or a float-time estimate.
